season.evidence: Histogram Jun 12, Jul 29, Aug 27, Sep 28, May 1, Oct 6. Stored Late May-June is too early: a late-May attempt met knee-deep slush and a cornice and turned back; a November attempt met 6-12 in of snow. Searches found no guidebook season for this peak.

track.why: Our catalog has one route on the peak; the June 25 2026 summited track follows the described line (waterfall ravine, bootpath, saddle, summit block), round trip 292/298 m from pin. It also visits Gunn.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jul 14 2022 round trip but start 314 m from pin.

facts.text: A brushy spur off the forest road about 1,000 ft before the Barclay Lake lot saves roughly 300 ft of walking but is overgrown; parking on the shoulder is easier.
In late May, continuous snow starts near 4,200 ft and becomes knee-deep slush by 5,000 ft, and a cornice overhangs the north approach to the summit.
In mid-July the climbers trail is overgrown up to and past the waterfall crossing; north-aspect snow patches are firm enough to walk on.
The final summit block is the crux: roughly 20 ft of exposed Class 4 on either the north gully or the south side, with chossy footing.
In mid-September, a short hand line slung on a horn at the summit helped with the exposed Class 4 downclimb on the south side.

notes: Our trailhead pin is about 300 m from where all tracks start; the tracks start at a spur nearer the road, so no pin move proposed.
